notes.title: Pretty Big Follow Up Patch
notes.content:
This Patch adds the following things...
-Update to all FireArm Damage to Enemies
-Update to some enemies
-Update to NPC Missions, they no longer spawn on your character, less intrusive, you will have to seek them out.
-Added a New Mission Generator NPC near your starting Home Location.
-Updated some of the Super Cars Weaponry to be more effective offensively also defensive counter measures added and useful! 
-Claws Weapons now do more damage, especially when combined with Super Strength.
